other_failure_modes.name: Shallow copy of PyTorch state_dict
other_failure_modes.description: Using `.copy()` on `model.state_dict()` creates a shallow copy of the dictionary, meaning the stored values are still references to the model's parameter tensors which continue to be updated in-place by the optimizer. This completely defeats early stopping because the 'best' weights will just reflect the final epoch's weights. (The correct approach is `copy.deepcopy(model.state_dict())` or cloning the tensors).

summary: The agent implemented a highly robust machine learning pipeline. It correctly uses a holdout validation set, applies feature engineering and scaling transformations strictly after splitting to prevent leakage, uses appropriate objective functions, and optimizes ensemble weights via SLSQP on out-of-fold predictions. The only notable flaw is a common PyTorch gotcha where the state dict is shallow-copied, breaking the early stopping mechanism for the neural network model.
